units: Targ. Job XL, 25 (ed. Wil. תַּקְדַח Af.).—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:10:2">Cant. R. to I, 10</cite> <he>למִקְדַּח</he>, v. <cite ref="H01647"><he>חֲרַז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:9">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>חזן</he> … <he>דקַדְחָא וכ׳</he> I saw (in my dream) a pomegranate sprouting through the mouth of a wine jar.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 28b:9">B. Bath. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דקַדְחָה ואכלה וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (Ar. <he>דקדח</he>, ed. <he>דקדיח</he>) it (clover or grass) grew forth, and he made use of it, and as it grew again (the next day), he made use of it &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:3">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> (Sodomitic justice) <he>הבה … עד דקדחא</he> (Ms. M. <he>דקדחה</he>) give him the ass (whose ear he had cut off), until its ear is grown again; a. e.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:11">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דקדחה לה עינא</he> her eye was inflamed.

senses.gloss: to dig out, make a path for. [Targ. Job l. c., v. supra.]—
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 4b:17">M. Kat. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>לאַקְדּוּחֵי נהר וכ׳</he> to clean the canal of B. (in the festive week).
